gain.note: Optional decay (e.g. per N ticks) can be added in content later; engine respects decay: false when absent.
gain.perCast: Each spell cast adds affinity to every rune in that spell's runeCombo.

evolution.example: minAffinityPerRune: 25 means all runes in the combo must have affinity >= 25 to unlock this evolution.
evolution.description: Evolution table rows can require minAffinityPerRune: for each rune in the spell's runeCombo, player's affinity for that rune must be >= minAffinityPerRune.

description: Rune affinity: how it is gained, how it gates evolution, and how it affects spell power at rune forge. Player state stores per-rune affinity (0–100).

spellCrafting.powerBonus: At rune forge, spell power can be boosted by affinity. Formula: basePower + sum over runes in spell of floor(affinity[rune] / 10). So 0–9 affinity = 0, 10–19 = +1, … 100 = +10 per rune. Content can override with a formulaId pointing to a formula pack.
spellCrafting.evolutionUnlockDisplay: UI can show 'Evolve (requires affinity 25+ per rune)' when minAffinityPerRune is set.
